baseline_failures: Native disabled during pending caused focus loss.
Ambiguous high-consequence timeout exposed an unsafe Retry action.
Cancel changed UI state but did not stop the underlying export, allowing Canceled to later become Export complete.
second_order_failure: When transient recovery controls such as Retry, Check status, or Cancel disappeared after activation, focus could fall to body unless an explicit focus destination was defined.
revisions: Use aria-disabled plus an activation guard where pending state must remain focusable.
Represent lost response after possible commit as outcome unknown, expose Check status, and withhold unsafe Retry.
Use operation identity and authoritative reconciliation before declaring the transfer confirmed.
Make Cancel actually stop the simulated operation and invalidate stale progress updates.
Restore focus from disappearing Retry, Check status, and Cancel controls to a stable logical control.
Keep live status regions non-interactive and separate from recovery actions.
final_assertions: status regions did not steal focus
scope_limit: Controlled same-document Chromium/JavaScript simulation only. No real HTTP request, server idempotency implementation, AbortController, offline/reconnect, screen reader, cross-browser/device, or human task evidence.
